# listing.gallery

TL;DR:
- listing.gallery is the canonical expanded photo container for the listing.

What it means:
- It contains the ordered image entries for the listing.
- It is preferred over galleryId when the workflow needs photos or media explanation.

Agent hint:
- Use the expanded gallery when you need to talk about listing images. See zbav://mcp/entity/gallery for full entity context.
